dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Big 'n' juicy grainfruits! Why don't you try one, Ma'am... Oh wait, do robots eat Grainfruit...?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Analyzing... Grainfruit can be added to a Krumkake recipe to significantly boost dietary fiber... One Grainfruit, please.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...If Aino consumes only Smetana and Lakkaberries, this does not constitute a balanced diet.
